company_profile: Revolut is a global financial app offering spending, saving, investing and exchange products to retail customers.
title: Data Scientist (NLP Deep Learning Engineer)
summary: Senior Data Scientist with 8+ years taking deep learning, NLP and LLM applications from research to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Builds chatbots and assistants with LangGraph multi-agent and RAG designs, fine-tunes transformer models such as cross-encoders for retrieval, and evaluates LLM systems with automated evaluators and tracing. Productionises models with Python, SQL, FastAPI, Docker and MLflow, working closely with product owners and business stakeholders. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Banking Support Copilot
bullets: Built a customer support copilot for digital banking that classifies incoming chats with a fine-tuned BERT model and drafts grounded replies with an LLM using RAG over help articles.
Evaluated intent accuracy and answer quality with LLM evaluators and human-labelled samples, then served both models through FastAPI in Docker with MLflow tracking and tracing.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Data Scientist (NLP Deep Learning Engineer) role at Revolut. My recent work is building LLM and NLP products that real users rely on: a multi-agent analytics chatbot, a document-extraction agent and a fine-tuned cross-encoder for retrieval. The thread through it all is shipping models, not just prototypes.

Revolut puts assistants and copilots in front of customers who manage their money every day, and that is where careful NLP work pays off most. There is a personal side too: my fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Porto together and settle there long term.

I would bring experience of the full path from idea to production. My LangGraph analytics chatbot for medical plans cut manual analysis by 98%, and the evaluation pipelines I built with LLM evaluators and tracing reduced human review by 43%. Both taught me to measure quality before scaling a feature.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me focused on how people actually use what I build, not just what the model can do. I would be glad to talk about how I could help your team.
